dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing initiated at the mid-section and progressing linearly toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity corresponds to a light-grey tone, transitional between juvenile grey and mature white phases.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse dark-grey clusters distributed primarily across the posterior half of the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope observed between the primary light-grey canvas and the localized darker mottled patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Series of transverse, linear topological ridges and associated shallow shadow-casting depressions spanning the dorsal axis, most prominent in the posterior region.
